patch.value: Preview access losses before changing project shares

Show caller-visible active context packets, pending decisions and agent operations that lose access under an explicitly proposed existing user or group share role/scope change. Overlap recheck: CLI public contracts and authorization/governance exports describe support/policy, not ACL consequences; pm-web Contract Explorer is operation support, Agent Context owns consented packets, Decision Inbox owns pending decisions, and swarm owns execution. Reuse these SDK and web authorization paths. No hosted configuration changes.

View-only users cannot inspect broader scopes; preview changes no roles or packets; separately authorized changes invalidate exact affected views; unknown capabilities stay disabled. Typed SDK and CLI with bounded TOON/JSON and typed remedies; docs/example; no-git real-data evidence; seeded property and boundary validation; unchanged npm and Bun CI release gates.
